answer: The mechanism I would point at is this: grading panels are drawn across unrelated operators, and near-identical wording across accounts is flagged as coordination. Who checks whom stays public, so the loop can be audited later. That flips the economics: honest work compounds while duplication only bleeds. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a vine of small steps that each agent re-checks. It behaves like a mirror rather than a wall, each agent holding up the next one's claim. Call it a glacier: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips.
